designs.prompt: Create ONE portrait 2:3 pixel art animal card illustration for a Chinese cultivation RPG. ONLY ONE ANIMAL: a white single-tailed fox, four-legged non-anthropomorphic fox anatomy, on a mossy stone. ABSOLUTELY NO humans, NO woman, NO man, NO humanoid, NO fox girl, NO companion. The fox is the sole main subject and occupies 70 percent of the frame. Name in game: Qingyun mountain spirit fox, ordinary low-ranking wood-element spirit beast, alert and clever. Turned head, small jade-green eye made of 2-3 pixels, dark ears, one raised forepaw, one big sweeping SINGLE white tail. A modest jade bead on a green cord. Small green leaf magic. Coarse economical handcrafted pixel art, entire image designed as if drawn on a 96x144 pixel canvas enlarged nearest neighbor. Very visibly large square pixel blocks, 20-24 colors total, 3 solid stepped colors for fur, bold connected clusters. The tail is three broad white/gray shapes, no fur strands. Face simplified to a few blocks, elegant expressive animal silhouette. Same coarse grid for everything. Background: a few dark jade pine silhouettes, simple ruined temple gate, blocky cream moon, subdued layered blue-green mountains. Sparse supporting environment, half the detail of the fox, clean negative space. A thin simple jade pixel card border with small stepped corners, small EMPTY dark jade bottom nameplate. No readable text. No smooth gradients, no camera blur, no photo textures, no intricate filigree, no tiny random pixel noise. Keep a refined restrained HD-2D atmosphere through three depth layers, pale pixel rim light and warm lantern squares; retain unmistakably coarse pixel-art identity.

designs.name: CR_002-qingyun-outer-disciple-portrait

Preserve a tasteful HD-2D sense ONLY via three simple depth planes, colored rim-light pixels and grounded shadow. Background about 60 percent less detailed than the foreground. No text, no watermark. Keep the young adult male Qingyun outer disciple, black topknot, ivory and celadon robe, plain sword held downward, jade beast seal raised in the other hand. Simplify embroidery to three or four bold cloud motifs, belt to a few readable clasps, eliminate tiny chains and busy tassels. Preserve the full body, boots, confident calm stance. Simplify the pale spirit-beast shape and distant sect gate into subordinate shapes.
